queries.result: Discovery identified ANCFCC as the national land-conservation, cadastre and mapping agency and returned its official Arabic portal, Nador office directory, cadastral product page, and online cadastral-plan request page. No public anonymous Nador parcel viewer/API or downloadable parcel geometry was found.
